title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: Witness remembers China trip

During the interjection of Senator Raffy Tulfo after the impeachment trial went on lunch break, Davao City assessor Engineer Jaime Adalin confirms a recent travel to China but denies recollection of a Chinese trip in November 2018.
This drew the ire of Tulfo again, who says Adalin traveled to China, and other countries including Australia.

“Gusto mo pati CCTV footage kaya ko ibigay sa ’yo. November 12, 2018, PR356 China. At two days ka lang sa China. At ang dami mong biyahe, engineer. Meron kang Hong Kong, meron kang Thailand, meron kang Australia,” says Tulfo.
“Hindi kita nilalait ha, pero magkano ba ang suweldo mo para ikaw ay palaging nag-a-abroad?” he asks, with Adalin answering he earns around P120,000 monthly.

blocks.text: 20 hours ago
Sara Duterte spox: Davao City assessor’s China trip ‘irrelevant’ to VP’s properties

Paolo Panelo, spokesperson of Vice President Sara Duterte, says the prosecution’s question on the supposed China-sponsored trip of Davao City Assessor Jaime Adalin is “irrelevant” in the Vice President’s alleged undeclared properties in Davao.

During the impeachment trial on November 9, 2026, the prosecution asked Adalin about the trip, but the latter said he could not recall it, even after he was reminded that the trip only happened the previous year. The prosecution said it wanted to establish the “evasiveness” of the witness.

blocks.text: 22 hours ago
Sara Duterte declared Matina Crossing property in 2024 SALN — witness

Davao City Assessor Engineer Jaime Adalin testifies before the impeachment court that the property in Matina Crossing, Davao City, identified in a tax declaration filed with the City Assessor’s Office, is the same property declared in Vice President Sara Duterte’s 2024 Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN).

The prosecution had previously alleged that Duterte failed to declare two properties in Davao: a lot in Matina, Davao City, which was sold to her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, for P6 million in July 2024; and a property in the Island Garden City of Samal, acquired for P3 million in 2018.

blocks.text: 23 hours ago
Defense begins presentation of evidence
The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte starts the presentation of evidence in the impeachment trial, with Davao City assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin presented as the first witness.
Adalin will to testify on Duterte’s alleged undeclared property in Barangay Matina Crossing, Davao City, on the 40th day of the trial on November 9, 2026.

blocks.text: Defense hopes to present Gencorp corporate counsel this week

Defense lawyer Michael Poa confirms that Gencorp Industries corporate counsel Suzette Balucanag-Punay will skip the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday, November 9 due to a previously scheduled MRI scan.
